name: comp-360

frames.best_why: Tooltip 'Pan top Cmd T' is open above the up arrow while the whole four-button pad is visible.

tagline: Four arrow buttons around a dot show shortcut hints when hovered.
summary: A small cluster of four outlined arrow buttons around a centre dot, laid out like a directional pad. Hovering any arrow opens a tooltip naming the pan direction and its keyboard shortcut.
appearance: Five tiny round-cornered outlined squares on a near-black page: one up arrow on top, left and right arrows on either side of a small outlined circle, and a down arrow at the bottom. A light tooltip with a dark key badge appears beside the hovered arrow.
behaviour: Hovering an arrow fades in a tooltip next to it with a direction label and a shortcut such as Cmd T; moving away fades it out again. The arrows are plain buttons.
demo_content: Tooltips read Pan top, Pan left, Pan right and Pan bottom with Cmd T, L, R and B shortcuts.
search_phrases: small arrow buttons with hover hints
icon button cluster with popup labels
use_when: Icon-only navigation buttons need discoverable labels and shortcut hints on hover.
avoid_when: Tooltips only appear on hover or focus, so touch users get no explanation of the arrows.
customise: Button icons, aria labels, tooltip text and shortcut keys are written inline, so changes require editing the source; each tooltip's side is set per button.
weight_why: Four small buttons and a tooltip; nothing animates until hover.

a11y.note: Each arrow has an aria-label and focus opens its tooltip, but the printed key hints are not announced as actual shortcuts.

issues: Buttons are visual only in this demo; no pan action is wired up.
The displayed shortcut keys are not bound to any handler in the code.
polish_why: Crisp, tidy icon buttons; it is a standard tooltip demo with no wired actions.
